fixes.found: At <=640px the palette panel stretches to 100dvh, but the legacy .palette-list max-height:420px remained. The result was a 420px result list and the hint bar at ~478px, leaving ~330px of empty panel below it.
fixes.fix: Reset .palette-list max-height at the mobile breakpoint so the flex list fills the panel and the hint stays at the bottom.
fixes.verification: 390x844 and 320x760, light+dark: list clientHeight 749/665, hint flush with panel bottom; desktop 1280 unchanged (420px list).

fixes.found: On phones the palette is a full-screen panel. The header only showed a non-interactive 'Esc' kbd label and the backdrop was fully covered, so touch users had no way to dismiss the palette without choosing a result.
fixes.fix: Added a 44px '关闭' button in the palette header, hidden on desktop and shown at <=640px; hid the non-applicable Esc badge on phones. The button calls closePalette(), which restores focus to the search trigger.
fixes.verification: 1280: close hidden, Esc badge shown. 390/320: close visible and 50x44; tapping it closes the palette, aria-expanded returns false, focus returns to #search-trigger.

fixes.found: Practice stimulus graphs are canvas bitmaps drawn once from live CSS variables. A runtime light↔dark toggle left the old background/axes/curve colors, producing a light graph block on the dark page (and vice versa). Resizing also left the bitmap at the old CSS width.
fixes.fix: Store the graph spec on the canvas and redraw all visible .stim-graph canvases on 'themechange' and 'resize' (rAF-throttled), with cleanup on route dispose. Also redraw after filter changes so cards hidden during a theme change catch up.
fixes.verification: All 42 practice units at 390: after a light→dark toggle every graph pixel matches the current --canvas-plot; resize 1280→390 updates canvas.width from 420 to 356; filter hide→toggle→show remains dark.

fixes.found: Practice SVG diagrams froze the light-theme text color inline (color:#131311), so after a runtime switch to dark theme diagram strokes and labels stayed near-black on the dark page.
fixes.fix: Let the SVG inherit color from its .stim-svg host (style=color:inherit), which is already bound to var(--text).
fixes.verification: All 42 practice units at 390 with .stim-svg content: after a light→dark toggle every SVG computed color equals its host color; before the fix it stayed rgb(19,19,17) while the host became rgb(244,244,239).

fixes.found: The shared select() helper rendered a visual label and a select control but did not associate them; the select had no accessible name.
fixes.fix: Generate a unique id per select, set it on the control, and point the label's for attribute at it.
fixes.verification: All 35 module pages: every .control-panel select resolves a matching label[for]; clicking the label focuses the select.

leftoversOutsideScope.detail: Many .exam-figure-cap elements have scrollHeight 4-7px larger than clientHeight because overflow-x:auto computes overflow-y:auto. Visible denominators/descenders can touch or clip at the caption edge. At 390px this affected 5/89 bio topic pages and at least one caption on 172/251 mech+em+math topic pages; it is also present on simulation modules such as #/m/projectile and #/m/electric-field.
leftoversOutsideScope.note: Not edited: interactive-figure sessions own the JS/HTML caption content, and this sweep was told not to change the shared .exam-figures/.exam-figure-cap layout rules. A safe owner-side fix is a caption descent strut/phantom or overflow-y: visible on the shared caption rule after their work settles.

leftoversOutsideScope.detail: Multiple figures/diagrams on one page reuse marker ids: figlib uses id="ah"; js/diagrams.js uses fbd/pul/pw/fw. IDs are document-global. Current markers are visually identical, so no visible break was observed, but ids should be unique per instance.
leftoversOutsideScope.note: js/diagrams.js was touched only for the theme-color fix; marker ids were left alone to avoid a refactor while another session is changing figures.

leftoversOutsideScope.detail: On #/m/electric-field the Wikimedia attribution link in the figure media is 256x15px, below the 44px touch target guideline.

concurrentWorkNote: During the sweep, an intermediate uncommitted math-figure revision briefly threw 'Cannot access D2R before initialization' and blanked math topic/map pages. The owner fixed it before the final scans; final math checks are clean. No files outside this session's scope were modified.

finalStatus.remainingFindings: Only the outside-scope caption clipping and low-risk duplicate-id/touch-target notes above.
